decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on the 31st March 2004, the matter described above is lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The proposed extension to the dwellinghouse of a gable end extending 3.8m from the existing hipped ridgeline, being 3.2m deep and having a base width of 9m, with a volume of 18.06m3, as well as a rear dormer with dimensions of 3.1m deep, 2.2m high with a width of 4m, that adds 13.64m3 together with the existing outbuilding, which has a volume of 31.25m3, providing a total extension volume of 62.95m3 to the original dwellinghouse, qualifies as Class B and C permitted development within Part 1 of Schedule 2 of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.

The proposed rear extension, therefore, does not require planning permission.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of roof extension to dwellinghouse.
